notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list places a tower here. The list draws on the NC FFLA site, a Gary Weber list and 1:100,000 USGS topo maps, and says it may include observation towers; it was last revised June 2021. Sheffield is not in our NHLR or FFLOS data. Two searches and a few page reads found no source on build date, staffing, fires or fate. The listed point is about 3.1 km north-west of the Wikipedia coordinates for the community (our calculation), so it may not be in the village. The list's entry reads '0 bm' in the NGS column; not interpreted. Verify the site before treating it as a lookout.
